pages.text: Returns the month of a time (1 to 12).$(br2)Without $(1)time$() the function uses the current time. It uses the time zone of the server.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the month, 1 to 12
$(1)CALL c0de/time/MONTH$(br)  PARAMETER time birthday ;$(br)  RESULT result month$()
